heading: INT. SEWING FACTORY - BREAK ROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. SEWING FACTORY - BREAK ROOM - DAY
A cinder-block room with a Formica table and a vending machine that hums.
Fabric dust hangs in the window light.
MAUDE (60s, grey bun, thimble on her finger) sits stirring tea.
ROSALIND (40s, supervisor's badge, fraying composure) stands at the door with a manila folder.
BUNNY (20s, new hire, bright scarf) perches on the vending machine's edge, swinging her feet.
Maude, I need to talk to you about Friday.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Then talk, Rosalind. I'm sitting.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: The line was short two hundred pieces. The lot was yours.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Two hundred is nothing. We lost twice that in March.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: Maude says the machines were running slow.
units.name: BUNNY

units.text: Bunny, I didn't ask you.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: I'm only saying what she told me.
units.name: BUNNY

units.text: She's a good girl, Rosalind. Leave her out of it.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: Maude, they're cutting the shift. Seventeen people. If I can't show a reason, it's all of us.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: You want to blame me.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: I want to know the truth.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: The truth is I've been on that floor since you were in diapers. The truth is you've forgotten who taught you the seam.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: That isn't fair.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: No. It isn't.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: Maybe I should go.
units.name: BUNNY

units.text: Stay.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Stay, Bunny. Hear how it's done.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: Maude, if you quit, it's the end of the matter. I'll put it in writing. No review.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: You'd like that.
units.name: MAUDE

units.text: I'd hate it. I'm asking anyway.
units.name: ROSALIND

units.text: Maude sets down her tea.
She slides the thimble off her finger and places it on the folder.
There. Now you owe me one.
units.name: MAUDE
